AC2b: wrote and ran my own verbatim-value-diff script — diff_keys=[], kk.Metadata.ogLocale="ru_RU" (correctly NOT yet "kk_KZ", confirming REQ-006 scope wasn't prematurely done). Read src/i18n/request.ts and src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx directly — both are locale-count-agnostic exactly as the requirement's 'verified current state' section claims, confirming no staleness in that description. Stopped the production server (killed PID listening on :3000) before completing this handoff. docs/agents/requirements.yaml REQ-005 entry checked: status is 'in_progress', which is correct pre-Step-6 state (DOC-UPDATER flips to 'done' at Step 6, after this step) — no staleness found; description's factual claims about request.ts/layout.tsx/LocaleSwitcher.tsx needing no change match what I independently verified. No regressions on /ru, /uz, /en. All 6 acceptance criteria independently confirmed PASS.
